title: Minimal angular velocity
description: Essential: Correctly states the final answer ω_min = 2qB/m.

title: Distance to asymptote
description: Essential: Correctly states the final answer D = d.

title: Conservation of angular momentum
description: Important: Applies the conserved quantity L_O + B(R·p) to relate initial and final states.

title: Translational velocity expression
description: Important: Derives or uses v_x = (qBd/(2m)) sinθ from the equations of motion.

title: Rotational equation integration
description: Important: Integrates the equation of motion (e.g., θ̈ ∝ -sinθ) to find ∫ sinθ dt.

title: Energy or torque analysis
description: Optional: Uses energy conservation or torque analysis to find the condition for orientation reversal.

title: Final velocity direction
description: Optional: Correctly identifies the asymptotic velocity direction (e.g., along +y).

title: Sign error in force/torque
description: Pitfall: Makes a sign mistake in the Lorentz force or cross products for the dipole.

title: Incorrect moment of inertia
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect moment of inertia (I ≠ m d²/2) for the dipole.

title: Misinterpreting asymptote condition
description: Pitfall: Assumes the center of mass stops or incorrectly sets θ(∞) for the asymptote.
